native_contract.entry_abi: void-like one-argument cdecl; argument is a pointer to at least two DWORD coordinates; native return is not claimed
reads_and_effects: mask DWORD 0x70cf8 to low 24 bits and OR 0x2c000000 once at entry
read signed WORD width/height and grid pointer from header pointer 0x70d44
read exactly input DWORD offsets +0 and +4; no input writes or third-coordinate read
signed IDIV x tile coordinate by width; signed y row coordinate and signed height clipping
scan 21 columns over up to 17 screen rows, wrapping columns at width
merge a run while signed(start WORD + 16*n) equals the next signed WORD; next cell is read before the >20 termination branch
write masked packet color at record +4, then read live WORD 0x73480 and store it at record +0xe before list linking and packet-kind branch
record low two tile bits choose 20-byte basic record or 40-byte textured quad; high-byte bit 0 chooses one of the two frame heads
rotate live frame heads through +0x70/+0x88 and +0x7c/+0x8c using repeated live frame-pointer loads; update cursor 0x73484
native_contract.width_zero: Native signed IDIV faults for zero width. The pinned VC5 x86 candidate uses its historical signed modulo operation, and a finite SEH differential checks the same divide-error code and cursor ordering.

scope: Bounded original-x86/source semantic differential for finite controlled tile headers and map prefixes. The source candidate runs directly; no original binary dispatch is used as production code.
limits: The fixture uses finite test-owned headers and grids; it does not establish the runtime allocation extent behind arbitrary resource headers.
The output list/frame backing is controlled fixture memory, not a proof of the production frame allocation capacity.
The 0x73480 WORD is mutable; the nonzero value is supplied in both oracle memory and the actual canonical storage provider for discrimination.
Zero-width behavior is checked under the pinned VC5 x86 code generation only; ISO C leaves division by zero undefined.
This supports semantic confidence only, not FUNCTION_MATCH, source identity, full renderer behavior, or pixel output.
contract: One pointer to two raw DWORD coordinates, cdecl command. Native signed width/height, modulo and clipping; 21 columns by 17 rows; signed run continuity; 20/40-byte packet writes including live WORD73480 at+e; linked frame heads and cursor. Resource/frame extents remain native preconditions.
pointer_normalization: Canonical fixture normalizes only known frame-list pointer cells and each emitted packet link. Other DWORDs remain byte-compared.

canonical_proof.scope: Five original/source tile writer comparisons/26 checks: joined runs, signed row clipping, column wrap, four packet kinds/list selection, nonzero packet WORD, head rotation and zero-width divide-error. Only known pointer fields normalized; controlled resource/frame/output buffers, no pixel or arbitrary allocation-capacity claim.
